instructions_to_main_agent: Build a single-page or rich multi-tab React app in JS/JSX with Lucide React icons, Recharts/Chart.js/Canvas for charts and network visualization, and Framer Motion for smooth cyber UI transitions.
Implement the dark cyber tactical aesthetic with deep background (#070A11), cyan/lime glowing highlights, glass cards (backdrop-blur-xl border border-cyan-500/20), and monospace indicators.

Ensure all interactive components (buttons, tabs, inputs, node clicks, simulation toggles) have explicit `data-testid` attributes (e.g. data-testid='twin-node-ad-01', data-testid='sim-toggle-isolate-host').

Include sample data for 12+ network nodes across 4 tiers (Perimeter, Core AD, Cloud Storage, Workstations), 5 active threat predictions, 8 MITRE techniques, and real-time interactive What-If simulation diffs.
Add a top command bar with live clock, global risk meter, twin sync pulse, and a Pitch Deck / Strategy drawer showcasing content directly from the CyberWorld AI PDF.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all). This breaks transforms. Always specify properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp tactical button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons. Use Lucide or Phosphor React icons instead.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, pulsing glowing indicators.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.
